defect: The fix replaces the per-block std::vector proxyFor (added by this change) with a lazily allocated pointer so that not every JitBlock constructs a vector, a performance optimization.
reason: A performance cost from an embedded std::vector is not a functional defect under the criteria; the DestroyBlock recursion slip of this change was repaired by another commit, not by this fix.

defect: In EndCurRenderStep the input-attachment branch picks RP_TYPE_COLOR_INPUT when depth/stencil is used and RP_TYPE_COLOR_DEPTH_INPUT when it is not; the ternary arms are swapped.
reason: The fix swaps exactly these two arms in the line this change added, and the inversion is apparent next to the depthStencil ternary just above it.

defect: The change strips the leading dot from the extension (ext.substr(1)) while the filter set is built with a leading dot ('.' + tmp), so no file matches and ZIP asset listings (post shaders on Android) come back empty.
reason: The fix removes the two added substr lines; seeing that Path::GetFileExtension returns the dot requires Path.cpp.

defect: In PostShader.cpp the fix only adds a Common/Log.h include and rewords a comment ('Hm, why?' to 'For VFS'); the Android listing bug it fixes was in AssetReader.cpp.
reason: The fix's changes to this file are an include and a comment, so no defect in this change's lines is repaired.

defect: sceKernelRegisterSubIntrHandler uses the assignment 'error = SCE_KERNEL_ERROR_FOUND_HANDLER' as an else-if condition (overwriting the returned error and always taking that branch), and the new release error log has a %08x without an argument.
reason: Both the = for == typo and the missing format argument are in lines this change added and are visible in the diff; the fix corrects exactly them.

defect: The fix replaces 'ent->name == NULL' with 'ent->name == 0' because name is a u32 guest address, removing a NULL-in-arithmetic compiler warning.
reason: Comparing the integer with NULL behaves the same as comparing with 0, so the fix is warning and style cleanup.

defect: The fix corrects the registers used by WrapI_UU64 (pre-existing code; this change only added a comment) and otherwise reindents; its rewrite of WrapU_II64I to r[6]/r[7] is equivalent to PARAM(2)/PARAM(3).
reason: The only functional repair is in a wrapper that predates this change; the wrappers added here are only reformatted.

defect: The fix only reformats sceGe.cpp (spacing, brace placement, line wrapping) and keeps the sub-interrupt enabling added by this change unchanged.
reason: Pure formatting in this file, no defect repaired.

defect: The fix reformats sceIo.cpp and reworks sceIoWaitAsync; the DEBUG_LOG this change moved in sceIoGetstat is only reindented.
reason: This change only moved a log line after __IoGetStat, which the fix keeps; nothing in its lines is repaired.

defect: The new binary_search lookup in GetBlockNumberFromEmuHackOp drops the !invalid check of the old linear scan and relies on normalEntry being sorted, which DestroyBlock breaks by zeroing normalEntry, so destroyed blocks are returned or live blocks missed.
reason: The fix re-adds the invalid check after binary_search and stops zeroing normalEntry; the dropped invalid check is visible in the diff.

defect: Bumping p.Section('FileNode', 1) to p.Section('FileNode', 2) makes version 2 the minimum, so savestates with FileNode version 1 fail to load despite the new 's >= 2' compatibility branch.
reason: The fix changes the call to Section('FileNode', 1, 2); knowing that the one-version overload sets the minimum needs ChunkFile.h.

defect: The directional-light prenormalization sets len = 1/len and then divides the components by len, multiplying them by the length instead of normalizing.
reason: The fix changes x / len to x * len in the lines this change added; the error is visible in the diff.

defect: ResizeFramebufFBO takes the snapshot 'VirtualFramebuffer old = *vfb' only after bufferWidth/Height and renderWidth/Height were updated, so the blit from the old FBO uses the new dimensions.
reason: The fix moves the snapshot before the size updates; the ordering error is in the new function and visible in the diff.

defect: PackFramebufferD3D11_ computes srcByteOffset but passes map.pData without it to ConvertFromRGBA8888, so readbacks with nonzero x/y read from the top-left of the staging texture.
reason: The fix adds srcByteOffset to the source pointer; the computed but unused variable is visible in the diff.

defect: SignalSema, WaitSema and WaitSemaCB are registered with WrapI_* wrappers that write v0 after the function returns, by which time the call may have switched threads, so the result lands in another thread's registers.
reason: The fix registers them with WrapV_* and has the functions RETURN before rescheduling; seeing that these functions switch threads needs sceKernelSemaphore.cpp.

defect: The fix makes DeleteSema/CancelSema void and calls RETURN before rescheduling so that v0 is written to the calling thread.
reason: DeleteSema already wrote its result after __KernelReSchedule before this change, and CancelSema was a stub that switched no threads at this commit, so the wrong-thread write was not introduced here.

defect: The warm-up added to sceMpegAvcDecode and sceMpegAtracDecode makes the first decode calls return ERROR_MPEG_NO_DATA, which breaks Grand Theft Auto - Vice City Stories.
reason: The fix removes the warm-up from both decode functions (lines this change added) and moves it to GetAvcAu/GetAtracAu; where the warm-up belongs is a hardware-behaviour question not visible from code.

defect: The fix fills mtime/ctime/atime (converted from milliseconds) and access in ParseFileInfo so savestate dates display for Android content URIs.
reason: This change only switched the sscanf format to PRIu64 and set isWritable; the missing time fields predate it.

defect: The fix removes the Android-only lastModified field from FileInfo once ParseFileInfo fills mtime/ctime/atime instead.
reason: Adding a separate lastModified field is not itself a defect (AndroidStorageFileSystem converted it correctly at this commit); its removal is cleanup accompanying a fix elsewhere.

defect: Update now sets status = SCE_UTILITY_STATUS_FINISHED whenever status is not RUNNING, so with the preceding FINISHED-to-SHUTDOWN switch the dialog flips between SHUTDOWN and FINISHED and other states such as INITIALIZE are clobbered.
reason: The fix removes the added assignment (and the switch); the interaction is visible in the diff.

defect: ReadAt loops 'while (readSize < bytes)' over SaveIntoCache/ReadFromCache, but at or past end of file ReadFromCache returns 0, so reads beyond the file loop forever.
reason: The fix breaks out when ReadFromCache returns 0; the non-terminating loop is in this new file and visible in the diff.

defect: stbi_load is asked for 4 components, but the copy allocates and copies x*y*n bytes where n is the file's original component count, so RGB images get a too-small buffer that callers read as RGBA.
reason: The fix uses x*y*4; the comment in the same block says n is the original count, so the error is visible in the diff.

defect: ThreadFrame now returns didAnything, false whenever the render queue is momentarily empty, but callers (SDL, headless hosts, Android) treat false as a request to leave their render loop.
reason: The fix removes didAnything, blocks until a task arrives and returns true; the meaning of false to the callers needs the other files.

defect: In the header the fix renames GLRRunType::END to PRESENT, makes Run return bool and drops a WaitUntilQueueIdle stub, interface changes that support the ThreadFrame fix in the .cpp.
reason: No defect lies in the header lines this change added; the repaired behaviour is in GLRenderManager.cpp.

defect: The fix changes the flipV texcoord formula from 1.0 - v_texcoord.y to 1.0 - v_texcoord.y * 2.0.
reason: This change only removed the invalid 'f' suffix; the formula it kept was the same before.

defect: ApplyWaveformEffect assigns the 32-bit send buffer accumulators directly into the s16 downsampled buffer, so values outside 16 bits wrap around and produce buzzing.
reason: The fix wraps these assignments in clamp_s16; the s32-to-s16 narrowing is in the added lines and visible in the diff.

defect: The fix halves the reverb input, drops the vLIN/vRIN scaling and widens Lout/Rout to int32 to stop integer wraparound.
reason: This change only removed the *4 index multipliers; the int16 accumulators and input scaling that wrap were there before.

defect: The fix stops the pure-3D-texture detection in PrepareBuildTexture from treating fake mipmap changes (Tactics Ogre) as 3D textures.
reason: The 3D-texture code the fix repairs is not in the PrepareBuildTexture added here; the fix message attributes the regression to the 3D texture support.

defect: The new GetBranchTargetNoRA computes the target as addr + (offset << 2) instead of addr + 4 + (offset << 2), so branch targets are off by one instruction.
reason: The fix adds the +4 in the function this change added (which copied the existing wrong formula); a reviewer who knows MIPS branch semantics can see it in the diff.

defect: The fix casts ARRAY_SIZE(alternateSpeedTable) to int in the loop bound to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: Warning-only cleanup; the loop behaves the same.

defect: The fix makes analog axis input respect the bAllowMappingCombos setting when building a mapping.
reason: That setting was introduced in July 2023 (b9327073bb), after this change, so the missing check is not a defect of this change.

defect: The condition now accepts GLES3 || NV_framebuffer_blit, but builds with MAY_HAVE_GLES3 still always call glBlitFramebuffer (absent on NV-only devices), and the #else branch calls glBlitFramebufferNV on builds where it may not exist.
reason: The fix selects the blit function by the runtime extension and limits the NV call to Android; the mismatch between the condition and the #ifdef branches is visible in the diff.

defect: DisassemblyFunction::getLineNum with findStart assumes every line is 4 bytes, so an address inside a two-opcode macro line is not found and 0 is returned, breaking stepping.
reason: The fix bounds each line by the next line's address; the same new file creates 8-byte macro lines, so the defect is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix replaces getWindowEnd with scrollStepping and getInstructionSizeAt so that stepping copes with variable-size disassembly lines.
reason: Variable-size lines arrived with the DisassemblyManager (a928c62, a month later); the fixed-size window end was correct when this change was made.

defect: The fix replaces the windowEnd-based scrolling in stepInto/stepOver with scrollStepping and steps over whole macro lines.
reason: The adaptation is needed because of the later DisassemblyManager macros, not because of a defect in this change's lines.

defect: The fix adds parentheses around 'hostThreadName && strcmp(...) != 0' to silence a precedence warning.
reason: && already binds tighter than ||, so the expression parses identically and behaviour does not change.

defect: The fix changes key parameters to std::string_view and corrects identifier typos (invertedContentDimension, controlMapper).
reason: Refactor and typo fixes; no defect is repaired.

defect: The new signal jump, call and return handlers change currentList->pc without calling UpdateCycles, unlike the regular JUMP/CALL/RET handlers, so GPU cycle accounting is wrong after a signal jump.
reason: The fix adds UpdateCycles before each pc change in the added handlers; the RET handler using UpdateCycles is in the diff context.

defect: CreateGraphicsPipeline now AddRefs every shader module and stores it in shaderModules, but ~D3D11Pipeline never releases them, leaking shader modules.
reason: The fix adds the Release loop to the destructor; the unbalanced AddRef is visible in the diff.

defect: The new fast paths in Jit_WeightsU16 read the third weight from weightoff instead of weightoff + 4 and, for 1 and 2 weights, leave the padding weights unzeroed that the generic loop zeroes.
reason: The fix corrects the offset and adds the zero stores in the switch this change added; both are visible against the generic loop in the diff.
